title.en: Classify networks by the area they cover
Give examples of PAN, LAN, MAN and WAN

say.en: Your earbuds talk to your phone, your lab computers talk to each other, your city's cable network spans many kilometres, and the Internet spans the globe. Networks come in sizes. In this lesson: Classify networks by the area they cover.
Give examples of PAN, LAN, MAN and WAN.

body.en: A Personal Area Network (PAN) connects one person's devices within about 10 m, using Bluetooth or USB. A Local Area Network (LAN) connects computers in a room, building or campus, up to about 1 km, using Ethernet cables, Wi-Fi, switches. A Metropolitan Area Network (MAN) covers a city, roughly 30–40 km, such as a cable TV or city broadband network. A Wide Area Network (WAN) connects LANs and MANs across cities, countries and continents; the Internet is the largest WAN.

narration.en: Networks grow from PAN, about 10 metres, to LAN, about a kilometre, to MAN, a city, to WAN, which spans countries. The Internet is the biggest WAN.
narration.kn: ಜಾಲಗಳು PAN (ಸುಮಾರು 10 ಮೀ), LAN (ಸುಮಾರು 1 ಕಿಮೀ), MAN (ಒಂದು ನಗರ), WAN (ದೇಶಗಳಾದ್ಯಂತ) ಎಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ WAN.

say.en: Networks grow from PAN, about 10 metres, to LAN, about a kilometre, to MAN, a city, to WAN, which spans countries. The Internet is the biggest WAN. PAN is approximately 10 metres.
say.kn: ಜಾಲಗಳು PAN (ಸುಮಾರು 10 ಮೀ), LAN (ಸುಮಾರು 1 ಕಿಮೀ), MAN (ಒಂದು ನಗರ), WAN (ದೇಶಗಳಾದ್ಯಂತ) ಎಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ WAN.

say.en: LAN is approximately up to 1 kilometre.
MAN is approximately 30-40 kilometres a city.
WAN: countries and continents; Internet.

narration.en: Networks are named by the area they cover. Move the second device further away and see which kind of network is needed to connect it. The rings are on a log scale: each ring is many times wider than the one inside it. Connect a printer in the next room. Which network is it? Your bank's branches in Mysuru and Delhi share data. Which network?
narration.kn: ಜಾಲಗಳನ್ನು ಅವು ವ್ಯಾಪಿಸುವ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಿಂದ ಹೆಸರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡನೇ ಸಾಧನವನ್ನು ದೂರ ಸರಿಸಿ ಅದನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಲು ಯಾವ ಜಾಲ ಬೇಕು ನೋಡಿ. ವೃತ್ತಗಳು ಲಾಗ್ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿವೆ: ಪ್ರತಿ ವೃತ್ತ ಒಳಗಿನದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಅನೇಕ ಪಟ್ಟು ಅಗಲ. ಪಕ್ಕದ ಕೋಣೆಯ ಪ್ರಿಂಟರ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಯಾವ ಜಾಲ? ಮೈಸೂರು ಮತ್ತು ದೆಹಲಿಯ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಶಾಖೆಗಳು ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಹಂಚುತ್ತವೆ. ಯಾವ ಜಾಲ?

i One person's devices, a few metres apart gives PAN.
ii Computers in one building gives LAN.
iii Spread across a city gives MAN.
iv Spread across countries gives WAN.
So the answer is i PAN, ii LAN, iii MAN, iv WAN.
